body.prompt: The first image is a real aerial photograph of Lisbon, Portugal, assembled from earlier photos of the same helicopter flight. Some areas are soft, stretched or still look like a 3D render (mostly near the edges and the far distance). Return the same photograph, pixel-aligned: same camera, same framing, same horizon, nothing zoomed, cropped or moved. Keep its exact colours, light, haze and every area that is already sharp and real. Re-photograph only the soft, stretched or render-looking areas so the whole picture is equally sharp, real and hyperrealistic: real roof tiles, windows and shutters, weathered plaster, real trees, cars and water. The second image is the 3D render of this exact view, the third its exact depth map and the fourth the exact outlines of every building, roof and street: the geometry must match them. Do not add, remove, move or resize any building or landmark.
